data.explanation: This letter confirms your admission, but your place is only reserved, not final. You must send officially certified (not just scanned) copies of your bachelor's degree certificate and transcript of records, plus certified translations if they are not already in German or English, so they arrive by the deadline shown. If they arrive later, the university may give your place to someone else. Make sure to get the certifications done with enough lead time, since certification and postage can take a while. If you're unsure how to get documents certified, your home university or a notary/embassy can usually help.
